target.title: fix: default TLS gateway deep links to port 443 when port is omitted
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users opening an `openclaw://gateway` deep link with TLS enabled and no explicit port would connect to port **18789** instead of **443** on iOS and macOS.

Setup codes and other gateway URL parsers in OpenClawKit already default TLS hosts to 443 when the port is omitted; the `openclaw://gateway` query parser did not.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use the same TLS default-port rule as setup-code and URL parsing in `DeepLinks.swift` (`tls ? 443 : 18789`) for the gateway deep-link query path.

## User Impact

TLS gateway deep links from QR codes or shared links reach the expected HTTPS/WSS endpoint without requiring an explicit port parameter.

## Evidence

Parity source in OpenClawKit:

- `apps/shared/OpenClawKit/Sources/OpenClawKit/DeepLinks.swift` (setup-code and URL paths already use `tls ? 443 : 18789`)

Added regression test:

- `DeepLinksSecurityTests.gatewayDeepLinkUsesTlsDefaultPortWhenPortMissing`
- OpenClawKit test target: `DeepLinksSecurityTests`
